description: Browse the Kurodyne Catalog category tree one level at a time. Categories describe what a product is for; list_product_types lists what products deliver. Returns bounded pages with the name, slug, and a description of each category's subject. Use the returned slugs as category filters for search_products and get_trending_products. To find products for a task, call search_products directly; a category only narrows a search.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page; requires the same parent as that call

parent.description: Parent category slug (omit for root categories)

name: list_categories
title: List categories
